hypotheses.hypothesis: Tight coupling between planning and reward-driven execution improves coherence for multi-step editing

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive perturbation of illumination parameters within physical bounds improves reconstruction fidelity under imperfect conditions

title: VCPIP1 drives diabetic cardiomyopathy by deubiquitinating AMPKγ1 and preventing AMPKα-γ subunit assembly in cardiomyocytes
